subject: Decision Making
title: Viking Rune Casting
description: A fast breakdown of Viking Rune Casting for builders.

hook.text: Vikings carved symbols on stones and cast them onto cloth. The pattern of fallen runes guided their choices.

buildup.text: Each rune had a meaning: wealth, danger, journey, harvest. Combinations told a story about what lay ahead.

discovery.text: Rune casting forced Vikings to slow down. Reading symbols created space between impulse and action.

twist.text: Vikings also used holmgang, formal duels, to settle disputes. Sometimes the decision tool was a sword.

climax.text: Every culture builds tools to slow down choices. Runes, oracles, and rituals all create a pause before action.

punchline.text: Cast the runes, pause, then choose. Every culture needs a thinking ritual.

quiz.question: What did rune casting and other ancient methods have in common?
options: They created a pause between impulse and decision
